neighbours.label: the split-off ' ab' opening 'abductors' or similar in anatomy lists (flexors and extensors, ab|ductors)
fire: Train flexors and extensors, abductors and adductors, each week.
The hip abductors and flexors were weak.
Stretch the calf muscles, abductors and hamstrings.
Weak knee extensors, abductors and rotators cause pain.
She tested wrist flexors, abductors and pronators.
The thigh adductors and abductors were sore.
Hip abductors help you stand on one leg.
He rehabbed hip extensors, abductors and calves.
quiet: Train flexors and extensors, biceps and triceps, each week.
The hip flexors and quads were weak.
Stretch the calf muscles, glutes and hamstrings.
Weak knee extensors, quads and rotators cause pain.
She tested wrist flexors, pronators and grip.
The thigh adductors and glutes were sore.
Hip flexors help you stand on one leg.
He rehabbed hip extensors, quads and calves.

short: split-off ' ab' in a muscle list
notes: Card: ' ab' 7 of the top 32. Probes: ' ab' 0.61; ' or' in a fighter-jet list 0.34 (not covered); 'Abs' 0.00; 'flexors and extensors' 0.14. The + pole is reflexes and gaze.
